Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_records, compound_structures, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno from parent CHEMBL3338195 to find child salts, then join child molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, compound_records to activities on record_id, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, compound_records to docs on doc_id, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter parent chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3338195', target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL395', and standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
